results.answer: If you do not answer bookkeeping queries within 5 working days, we will park the unresolved items in a suspense account so the month can close. Parked items can distort your management report until they are resolved, so it is best to reply to our queries promptly.
sources: Monthly Bookkeeping Process > Queries

results.answer: Forward the SARS letter to us within 2 working days, as SARS letters often have response deadlines of 21 business days, and that clock starts when SARS sends the letter, not when you read it. We will log the letter, note the deadline, tell you what SARS is asking for, collect the documents needed, prepare the response and send you a copy for approval before submitting it on eFiling. Please don't ignore the letter, and don't share your eFiling password. A consultant can review your specific situation and the best next steps.

results.answer: Our invoices are payable within 14 days. We accept EFT only, and you should use your invoice number as the payment reference. If you disagree with an invoice, let us know within 7 days of receiving it.

results.answer: Overdue accounts are charged interest at 1.5% per month. We also send a reminder after 14 days, and after 30 days we may pause work and monthly services.

results.answer: For a company's annual financial statements we ask for: bank statements for all company accounts for the full financial year; sales invoices and a debtors list at year end; supplier invoices and a creditors list at year end; payroll records (payslips, EMP201 and EMP501 reconciliation, IRP5 summary); VAT201 returns and proof of payment; loan agreements and statements, including director and shareholder loans; a fixed asset register with purchases and disposals; and stock count sheets if the company holds stock. We also need company records such as the CIPC annual return, latest registration certificate, directors' and shareholders' meeting minutes, the share register and any share transfers, and details of any changes to directors or the registered address. Documents must be sent by the deadline in our late-documents policy.
sources: Document Checklist: Company Annual Financial Statements > Records we need

results.answer: Our checklist for individual tax returns says a home office claim needs an employer confirmation that you must work from home, the floor area of the office and of the home, and your monthly home costs. Whether you can claim, and how much, is a personal tax question, so a consultant should review your situation.
sources: Document Checklist: Individual Tax Return > Needed if they apply to you

results.answer: Please don't email your ID copy or bank statements in plain email, and don't send them through social media or messaging apps. Use our secure upload method instead, as set out in our document storage guidance. Also keep your SARS eFiling password private, as we never need it. If you're unsure how to start the secure upload, our team can help you get set up.
sources: Document Storage and Secure Upload > What not to do

results.answer: Urgent work is accepted when capacity allows. A consultant confirms the urgent fee and date in writing before we start, so we can't quote a fixed figure here. If you miss one of our internal cut-off dates, work outside the normal turnaround is treated as urgent and charged at 25% above the normal fee. For an urgent SARS or payment problem, call the front desk and ask for a callback from the tax manager the same day.

results.answer: We're open Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:30. We're closed on weekends and public holidays. On the last two working days of each month, phone lines are limited while we close month-end books, but email is monitored as usual.
